description.value: Halfmoon General is the longest-running business in Halfmoon Bay, operating since 1937 on BC's Sunshine Coast in a location once served by Union Steamship Co. The store combines a grocery section stocked with locally sourced and produced goods, a liquor store featuring Sunshine Coast craft beverages, and a dog-friendly café with a patio overlooking the ocean — a natural resupply and rest stop for cyclists on the Sunshine Coast route.

address.value: 5642 Mintie Road, Halfmoon Bay, BC V7Z 1E8
